title: The Importer That Splits Customer Names
description: Quoted customer names split into extra columns and doubled quotes are silently stripped during a CSV import.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: parse_row(line) parses one CSV record into string fields. Support comma separators, quoted commas, doubled quotes inside quoted fields, empty fields, and a trailing empty field. Quotes must begin at field start and close before a separator/end. Reject malformed or unterminated quotes and CR/LF (one record only). Empty input is one empty field. C++ returns vector<string>.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
